title: The Lord Visits Abraham

questions.question: How many men appeared to Abraham at Mamre?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:2: Three men stood before Abraham.

questions.question: What did Sarah do when she heard she would have a son?
What famous question did the LORD ask about His power?
options: Is anything too hard for the LORD?
questions.correctAnswer: Is anything too hard for the LORD?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:14: "Is anything too hard for the LORD?"

questions.question: Which cities was the LORD going to examine for sin?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:20: The LORD spoke about Sodom and Gomorrah's sin.

questions.question: Did Abraham intercede for the cities?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:23-32: Abraham negotiated with God about sparing the righteous.

questions.question: Where was Abraham sitting when the visitors appeared?
options: At the door of his tent
questions.correctAnswer: At the door of his tent
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:1: Abraham sat at the tent door in the heat of the day.

questions.question: What food did Abraham prepare for the visitors?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:6-8: Abraham prepared a generous meal including a tender calf.

questions.question: What was the starting number Abraham asked about for sparing Sodom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:24: Abraham started by asking about fifty righteous people.

questions.question: What was the final number Abraham negotiated down to?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:32: Abraham stopped at ten righteous people.

questions.question: Did Sarah deny laughing?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:15: Sarah denied it because she was afraid.

questions.question: Why did the LORD say He would not hide His plans from Abraham?
options: Abraham would become a great nation and all nations blessed through him
questions.correctAnswer: Abraham would become a great nation and all nations blessed through him
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:17-18: God shared His plans because of His covenant with Abraham.

questions.question: What phrase describes the sin of Sodom in this chapter?
Where were the oaks where Abraham was camping?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:1: The LORD appeared at the oaks of Mamre.

questions.question: What did Abraham call himself when speaking to the LORD?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:27: "I who am but dust and ashes."

questions.question: When would the LORD return for Sarah to have her son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 18:14: "At the appointed time I will return to you, about this time next year."

key_verse_text: 'Is anything too hard for the Lord? At the appointed time I will return to you, about this time next year, and Sarah shall have a son.'
